returns: A native-backed instance of this class or a subclass (WINDOW itself is abstract).
description: CLOS wrapper for a two-state wxCheckBox.
scope: Construction requires an active main-thread application session. Concrete classes create their native widgets in inherited INITIALIZE-INSTANCE methods; subclass AFTER hooks can use them. Native handles cannot be supplied as initargs. Lisp subclassing does not imply native C++ virtual callbacks.
wxwidgets: wxCheckBox (wxWidgets 3.2); this is a Lisp wrapper, not a native subclass.

construction.description: PARENT is required; LABEL defaults to empty, CHECKED to NIL. Class :DEFAULT-INITARGS and custom slot initargs are honored; native creation precedes subclass AFTER hooks.

name: gauge
arguments: Native-backed WINDOW subclass. Required :PARENT; :RANGE defaults to 100, :VALUE to 0, :ORIENTATION to :HORIZONTAL.
returns: A gauge wrapper or Lisp subclass instance.
description: Parent-owned progress indicator; supports inherited window operations. Positive range, value from zero through range, horizontal or vertical orientation. IDs, position, size, validator and native name use wxWidgets defaults; custom styles, taskbar progress and two-step creation remain unbound.
scope: Requires a live gauge in an active main-thread GUI session. Stale/destroyed handles, native type errors and values above the range signal NATIVE-ERROR; wrong Lisp receivers use CLOS dispatch errors. Numeric arguments must fit signed 32-bit integers; invalid Lisp types/ranges signal TYPE-ERROR. No command events or native virtual overrides.

construction.description: Subclass slot initargs and :DEFAULT-INITARGS are supported. Native properties are ready in subclass AFTER hooks. Failed managed initialization rolls back native allocation. Orientation is :HORIZONTAL or :VERTICAL and cannot be changed after construction.

name: make-gauge
arguments: PARENT is a WINDOW; :CLASS defaults to GAUGE. :RANGE, :VALUE, :ORIENTATION and subclass initargs are forwarded.
returns: A new GAUGE instance of CLASS.
description: Thin MAKE-INSTANCE factory with validated GAUGE subclass support. Same construction defaults and restrictions as GAUGE.
scope: Requires a live gauge in an active main-thread GUI session. Stale/destroyed handles, native type errors and values above the range signal NATIVE-ERROR; wrong Lisp receivers use CLOS dispatch errors. Numeric arguments must fit signed 32-bit integers; invalid Lisp types/ranges signal TYPE-ERROR. No command events or native virtual overrides.

name: gauge-value
arguments: GAUGE is a live gauge; SETF VALUE is an integer from 0 through GAUGE-RANGE.
returns: Integer progress; SETF returns the supplied integer.
description: Read determinate progress. After PULSE-GAUGE the reading is platform-dependent; do not interpret it as completed work. Assigning a value restores determinate mode without events.
scope: Requires a live gauge in an active main-thread GUI session. Stale/destroyed handles, native type errors and values above the range signal NATIVE-ERROR; wrong Lisp receivers use CLOS dispatch errors. Numeric arguments must fit signed 32-bit integers; invalid Lisp types/ranges signal TYPE-ERROR. No command events or native virtual overrides.

setf.description: VALUE must be an integer in [0, range]. Invalid updates preserve existing progress. No notification option.

name: gauge-range
arguments: GAUGE is a live gauge; SETF VALUE is an integer in [1, 2147483647].
returns: Positive integer maximum; SETF returns the supplied integer.
description: Read or assign the maximum progress. Assignment clamps the current native value to the new range and restores determinate mode by calling SetRange followed by SetValue. After a pulse the preserved value is platform-dependent; explicitly set GAUGE-VALUE when resuming measured work.
scope: Requires a live gauge in an active main-thread GUI session. Stale/destroyed handles, native type errors and values above the range signal NATIVE-ERROR; wrong Lisp receivers use CLOS dispatch errors. Numeric arguments must fit signed 32-bit integers; invalid Lisp types/ranges signal TYPE-ERROR. No command events or native virtual overrides.

setf.description: A positive signed 32-bit integer. Progress becomes MIN(old native value, new range); no events. Zero ranges are intentionally unsupported.

name: gauge-vertical-p

returns: T for vertical, NIL for horizontal.
description: Query construction orientation; this property has no writer.

name: pulse-gauge
arguments: GAUGE is a live gauge.
returns: The supplied gauge.
description: Request platform-native indeterminate progress. Call periodically while keeping the GUI event loop responsive. Visual animation and value readings vary by platform; no timer, worker dispatch or completion event is provided. SETF GAUGE-VALUE restores determinate mode.
scope: Requires a live gauge in an active main-thread GUI session.
